scope: Outdoor Legion map 1220, 33 existing world quest EventObject introductions

data.source: Deployed Legion 7.3.5 World smart_scripts and conditions, plus loaded Quest and Conversation data
data.links: Events 200, 203 and 225 retain the original LINK rows after the single on-enter conversation root

cause: EventObject recorded the entry even when the native SmartEvent quest condition initially rejected the conversation. Accepting the quest while inside then required a second entry.
repair: Check the existing source-13 conditions for root 0 before recording entry on the scoped outdoor events. Keep the native SmartScript dispatch, range, player admission, linked actions and per-stay suppression.

native_checks.counterfactual: Test-LegionAreaDialogueNative.ps1 -LateBaseline linked against the pre-fix game.lib. All 33 accepted-in-place introductions were suppressed until the simulated player actually left and re-entered the trigger radius.
native_checks.regression: 165 cases over 33 roots using the loaded EventObject, SmartScript, Condition and Conversation dispatch. Covered unavailable, incomplete, complete and rewarded states, late acceptance, repeat polling, exit/re-entry, native conversation ownership and no progress changes. Two temporary migration replays.
native_checks.historical_baseline: The earlier -Baseline counterfactual for the incorrect source-10 conditions also requires the old game.lib because the repaired entry guard requires the source-13 root conditions.
native_checks.retained: 94 linked area credit/party/EO322-to-323 ordering cases and 60 additional area, party, Black Rook and real receiver delivery cases passed.

deployment.pe_check: The original final-link inputs were checked. verify_area_completion_release.py verified the 38 scoped entries in both staged and canonical binaries. The canonical Scepter login PE check passed.
deployment.startup: The task-owned canonical worldserver PID 18984 reported ready and exited 0 via server shutdown 0.
deployment.diagnostics: No new or changed crash reports, DBErrors or unexplained server warnings, errors or assertions. Owned server stderr was empty. Canonical DBErrors.log is 0 bytes and Crashes is empty.

open.client: Actual introduction playback, audio and traversal remain unverified.
open.rotation: Native tests change the quest status in the fixture. Hourly rotation registers active tasks in QuestDataStoreMgr, while Player::Update only calls UpdateArea on an area transition. Stationary world task publication therefore needs a separate repair and a test using actual rotation eligibility.
